title: Even Lower Fire
description: A PVP mechanism where fire is lower.
body:
Low Fire — PvP Visibility Pack
Tired of getting torched mid-fight and losing your target behind a wall of flame? This pack shrinks the fire overlay down to a small, animated flicker around your feet instead of the full-screen fire vanilla gives you when you're burning or standing in fire.
What it changes:

Fire animation height reduced — no more losing sight of your opponent while you're on fire
Still fully animated (16-frame flicker), not just a static texture
Vanilla-friendly — this is the only change, no other textures touched
No gameplay changes, no unfair advantage — purely visual, safe for any server
